<style>
#tarefas-root{
  width:min(1320px,100%);
  margin:0 auto
}
.tasks-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:10px
}
.tasks-head h2{
  margin-bottom:2px
}
.tasks-summary{
  display:flex;
  gap:7px;
  flex-wrap:wrap
}
.tasks-summary span{
  padding:6px 9px;
  border:1px solid #cbdde2;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#456572;
  background:#f5fafb;
  font-size:9.5px
}
.tasks-summary strong{
  margin-right:3px;
  color:#0b6f7b
}
.tasks-section{
  margin-top:10px
}
.tasks-section-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:6px
}
.tasks-section-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:13px
}
.tasks-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:8px
}
.task-card{
  display:flex;
  min-height:130px;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:7px;
  padding:12px;
  border:1px solid #c9dce1;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,48,70,.05)
}
.task-card.done{
  opacity:.78;
  background:#f7fafb
}
.task-card-top{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:8px
}
.task-card-top strong{
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.25
}
.task-status{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  padding:4px 6px;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#0b6874;
  background:#e7f4f5;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:750
}
.task-status.done{
  color:#526a74;
  background:#edf2f4
}
.task-card-meta{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:4px 8px
}
.task-card-meta span{
  min-width:0;
  color:#687e87;
  font-size:8.8px
}
.task-card-meta b{
  display:block;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin-top:1px;
  color:#325664;
  font-size:9.7px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.task-card .actions{
  margin-top:auto;
  padding-top:3px
}
.task-empty{
  padding:18px;
  border:1px dashed #bdd2d8;
  border-radius:10px;
  color:#6b8088;
  text-align:center;
  background:#f8fbfc
}
.task-dialog{
  width:min(980px,calc(100vw - 28px));
  max-height:90vh;
  padding:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #b9d3d9;
  border-radius:14px;
  color:#173f51;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(6,35,48,.28)
}
.task-dialog::backdrop,
.task-process-dialog::backdrop{
  background:rgba(8,31,44,.55);
  backdrop-filter:blur(5px)
}
.task-process-dialog{
  width:min(520px,calc(100vw - 28px));
  padding:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #b9d3d9;
  border-radius:13px;
  color:#173f51;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(6,35,48,.30)
}
.task-process-shell{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column
}
.task-process-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  padding:13px 15px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)
}
.task-process-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:15px
}
.task-process-head p{
  margin:2px 0 0;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
  font-size:9px
}
.task-process-head button{
  min-height:27px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)
}
.task-process-body{
  padding:13px 15px 15px
}
.task-process-body>.field{
  margin-top:9px
}
.task-process-body input{
  font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;
  letter-spacing:.02em
}
.task-process-actions{
  justify-content:flex-end;
  margin-top:10px
}
.task-dialog-shell{
  display:flex;
  max-height:90vh;
  flex-direction:column
}
.task-dialog-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  padding:14px 16px 12px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)
}
.task-dialog-head h3{
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:16px
}
.task-dialog-head p{
  margin:3px 0 0;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);
  font-size:9.5px
}
.task-dialog-head button{
  min-height:28px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  color:#fff;
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)
}
.task-dialog-body{
  overflow:auto;
  padding:13px 15px 15px
}
.task-distribution-banner{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr .8fr;
  gap:7px;
  margin-bottom:9px
}
.task-distribution-banner>div{
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #c6dce1;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#f2f8f9
}
.task-distribution-banner span{
  display:block;
  color:#6c828b;
  font-size:8.5px
}
.task-distribution-banner strong{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#0b6571;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-detail-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:6px;
  margin-bottom:10px
}
.task-detail-item{
  min-width:0;
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #dae6e9;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#fbfdfd
}
.task-detail-item span{
  display:block;
  color:#72868e;
  font-size:8.3px
}
.task-detail-item strong{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  color:#2f5260;
  font-size:9.7px
}
.task-dialog-section{
  margin-top:10px
}
.task-dialog-section h4{
  margin:0 0 6px;
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-lawyers{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px
}
.task-lawyer{
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d5e4e7;
  border-radius:7px;
  color:#315663;
  background:#f8fbfc;
  font-size:9px
}
.task-docs-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:6px
}
.task-docs-head h4{
  margin:0
}
.task-download-all{
  min-height:28px;
  padding:5px 9px;
  border-color:#b8d5da;
  color:#0b6572;
  background:#edf7f8;
  box-shadow:none;
  font-size:8.8px;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.task-download-all:hover{
  color:#fff;
  border-color:#0b7884;
  background:#0b7884;
  box-shadow:none
}
.task-docs{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px
}
.task-doc{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d5e3e7;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#fbfdfd
}
.task-doc strong{
  display:block;
  color:#315461;
  font-size:9.2px
}
.task-doc small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:1px;
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#7a8d94;
  font-size:8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.task-doc a{
  font-size:8.5px
}
.task-dialog-actions{
  position:sticky;
  bottom:0;
  display:flex;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:6px;
  margin:12px -15px -15px;
  padding:9px 15px;
  border-top:1px solid #d6e3e6;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)
}
.task-complete-box{
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid #bcd8de;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#f1f8f9
}
.task-complete-box h4{
  margin:0 0 4px;
  font-size:11px
}
.task-complete-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1fr) auto auto;
  gap:6px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-top:7px
}
.task-complete-row .field{
  margin:0
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .tasks-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .task-detail-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .tasks-grid,
  .task-lawyers,
  .task-docs,
  .task-distribution-banner,
  .task-detail-grid,
  .task-complete-row{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .task-dialog{
    width:calc(100vw - 16px)
  }
  .task-dialog-actions{
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .task-dialog-actions button{
    width:100%
  }
  .task-docs-head{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .task-download-all{
    width:100%
  }
}


/* Tarefas internas — cartões, anexos e diálogo */
.task-general-card{border-left:4px solid #0b7e89}
.task-general-card.done{border-left-color:#8a9ba1}
.task-general-description{margin:0;color:#607781;font-size:8.8px;line-height:1.4;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.task-priority{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;font-size:7.3px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}
.task-priority.baixa{color:#526b75;background:#edf3f5}
.task-priority.normal{color:#0b6874;background:#e7f4f5}
.task-priority.alta{color:#8a5928;background:#fff1df}
.task-priority.urgente{color:#9c342f;background:#fde8e6}
.task-general-dialog{width:min(900px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:90vh;padding:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #b9d3d9;border-radius:14px;color:#173f51;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(6,35,48,.28)}
.task-general-dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(8,31,44,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
.task-general-dialog-shell{display:flex;max-height:90vh;flex-direction:column}
.task-general-dialog-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px 12px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)}
.task-general-dialog-head h3{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:15px}
.task-general-dialog-head p{margin:3px 0 0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);font-size:9px}
.task-general-dialog-head button{min-height:28px;padding:4px 8px;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.task-general-dialog-body{overflow:auto;padding:13px 15px 15px}
.task-general-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.task-general-overview>div{padding:8px;border:1px solid #d4e3e6;border-radius:7px;background:#f8fbfc}
.task-general-overview span{display:block;color:#73878f;font-size:8px}
.task-general-overview strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#315563;font-size:9.4px}
.task-general-text{margin:9px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d9e5e8;border-radius:8px;background:#fbfdfd;color:#3e5e69;font-size:9.4px;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre-wrap}
.task-general-panel{margin-top:10px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #e0e9eb}
.task-general-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.task-general-panel-head h4{margin:0;font-size:11px}
.task-general-panel-head input[type=file]{display:none}
.task-general-files{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.task-general-file{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid #d5e3e7;border-radius:7px;background:#fbfdfd}
.task-general-file strong{display:block;overflow:hidden;color:#315461;font-size:9px;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.task-general-file small{display:block;margin-top:1px;color:#7b8e95;font-size:7.8px}
.task-chat{display:flex;max-height:260px;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;overflow:auto;padding:5px 1px}
.task-chat-message{padding:8px 9px;border:1px solid #d7e4e7;border-radius:9px;background:#f8fbfc}
.task-chat-message.mine{border-color:#bcdde0;background:#eef8f8}
.task-chat-message-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:3px}
.task-chat-message-head strong{color:#315461;font-size:8.6px}
.task-chat-message-head span{color:#819198;font-size:7.5px}
.task-chat-message p{margin:0;color:#45636e;font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap}
.task-chat-empty{padding:12px;border:1px dashed #c9dadd;border-radius:8px;color:#758991;text-align:center;font-size:8.7px}
.task-chat-compose{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px;align-items:end;margin-top:7px}
.task-chat-compose textarea{min-height:62px;resize:vertical}
.task-general-dialog-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:11px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #dbe6e9}
@media(max-width:980px){.task-general-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:650px){.task-general-overview,.task-general-files,.task-chat-compose{grid-template-columns:1fr}.task-general-dialog{width:calc(100vw - 16px)}.task-general-dialog-actions{flex-direction:column}.task-general-dialog-actions button{width:100%}}



/* Tarefas V2 */
.tasks-head{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto!important;
  gap:14px!important;
  align-items:center!important
}
.tasks-head-actions{
  display:flex;
  gap:8px;
  justify-content:flex-end
}
.tasks-filterbar{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,1.5fr) repeat(3,minmax(150px,.65fr));
  gap:8px;
  margin:12px 0 18px;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--pda-line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.95);
  box-shadow:var(--pda-shadow-soft)
}
.tasks-filterbar input,
.tasks-filterbar select{
  min-height:38px!important
}
.tasks-summary{
  display:flex!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  align-items:center!important
}
.tasks-summary-item{
  display:inline-flex;
  gap:4px;
  align-items:baseline;
  padding:6px 9px;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#49636c;
  background:#edf4f2;
  font-size:8.5px
}
.tasks-summary-item strong{
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  font-size:13px
}
.tasks-summary-item.urgent{
  color:#8b4b35;
  background:#fff0e8
}
.tasks-summary-item.urgent strong{
  color:#c65a43
}
.task-tags{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:5px;
  margin:7px 0 2px
}
.task-tag{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:21px;
  padding:3px 7px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d) 45%,white);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d) 10%,white);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.03em
}
.task-card{
  position:relative
}
.task-card.due-96{
  border-color:#e5b96d!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #d49a42,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.task-card.due-24{
  border-color:#e19069!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #dc704d,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.task-card.overdue{
  border-color:#d77e76!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #c65349,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important;
  background:#fff9f7!important
}
.task-card.done{
  opacity:.84
}
.tasks-history-button{
  border-color:#cbd9db!important;
  color:var(--pda-ink)!important;
  background:#fffdfa!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .tasks-head{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important
  }
  .tasks-head-actions{
    justify-content:flex-start
  }
  .tasks-filterbar{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr
  }
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .tasks-filterbar{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}

.task-card .actions button:not(.secondary){
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--task-accent,var(--pda-sea)),
      color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-accent,var(--pda-sea)) 78%,#07364b)
    )!important
}


/* =========================================================
   TAREFAS — LISTA OPERACIONAL COMPACTA
   ========================================================= */
.tasks-grid{
  grid-template-columns:1fr!important;
  gap:5px!important
}
.task-card{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(230px,1.2fr) minmax(360px,1.8fr) minmax(110px,.65fr) auto;
  gap:8px 12px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  min-height:70px!important;
  padding:8px 10px!important;
  border-radius:9px!important
}
.task-card-top{
  align-items:center!important;
  margin:0!important
}
.task-card-top strong{
  font-size:9.6px!important;
  line-height:1.2!important
}
.task-status{
  padding:3px 5px!important;
  font-size:6.8px!important
}
.task-card-meta{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:4px 7px!important;
  margin:0!important
}
.task-card-meta span{
  font-size:6.9px!important
}
.task-card-meta b{
  margin-top:0!important;
  font-size:8px!important
}
.task-general-description{
  display:none!important
}
.task-tags{
  align-content:center!important;
  margin:0!important;
  gap:3px!important
}
.task-tag{
  min-height:18px!important;
  padding:2px 5px!important;
  font-size:6.4px!important
}
.task-card .actions{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-wrap:nowrap!important;
  justify-content:flex-end!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:4px!important;
  margin:0!important;
  padding:0!important
}
.task-card .actions button{
  min-height:28px!important;
  padding:5px 7px!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:7px!important
}
.task-card.due-96,
.task-card.due-24,
.task-card.overdue{
  box-shadow:
    inset 3px 0 0 var(--task-accent,var(--pda-sea)),
    var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.task-card.due-96{
  --task-accent:#d49a42
}
.task-card.due-24{
  --task-accent:#dc704d
}
.task-card.overdue{
  --task-accent:#c65349
}
@media(max-width:1180px){
  .task-card{
    grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,1fr) minmax(330px,1.5fr) auto!important
  }
  .task-card .task-tags{
    display:none
  }
}
@media(max-width:850px){
  .task-card{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important;
    gap:6px!important;
    min-height:0!important
  }
  .task-card-meta{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important
  }
  .task-card .task-tags{
    display:flex
  }
  .task-card .actions{
    justify-content:flex-start!important
  }
}


/* Etapa 3 — linha operacional ainda mais estreita */
.task-card{
  grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,1.25fr) minmax(300px,1.55fr) minmax(92px,.45fr) auto!important;
  min-height:56px!important;
  padding:6px 8px!important;
  gap:5px 9px!important;
  cursor:pointer
}
.task-card:hover{
  border-color:#b9ceca!important;
  background:#fffefb!important;
  box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(8,68,80,.09)!important
}
.task-card:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid rgba(15,102,115,.22);
  outline-offset:1px
}
.task-card-top strong{
  font-size:9px!important
}
.task-card-meta{
  gap:2px 6px!important
}
.task-card-meta span{
  font-size:6.4px!important
}
.task-card-meta b{
  font-size:7.4px!important
}
.task-state-group{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:3px
}
.task-new-movement{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:18px;
  padding:2px 6px;

  function money_(value){

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
    return d.length===11

      :String(value||'');
  }

  function processMask_(value){
    const d=String(value||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,20);
    let out=d.slice(0,7);
    if(d.length>7)out+='-'+d.slice(7,9);
    if(d.length>9)out+='.'+d.slice(9,13);
    if(d.length>13)out+='.'+d.slice(13,14);
    if(d.length>14)out+='.'+d.slice(14,16);
    if(d.length>16)out+='.'+d.slice(16,20);
    return out;
  }

  function date_(value){
    const text=String(value||'').trim();
    if(!text)return 'â€”';
    const m=text.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
    return m?m[3]+'/'+m[2]+'/'+m[1]:text;
  }

  function dateTime_(value){
    const text=String(value||'').trim();

  function priority_(value){

  function bytes_(value){
    const n=Number(value||0);
    if(!n)return '';
    if(n<1024)return n+' B';
    if(n<1024*1024)return (n/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB';
    return (n/(1024*1024)).toFixed(1)+' MB';

  function validatePdfFiles_(files){
    const list=Array.from(files||[]);

    list.forEach(file=>{
      const name=String(file&&file.name||'');

      if(

  }

  function fileBase64_(file){

      const reader=new FileReader();

      reader.onerror=()=>reject(

        ['TAREFA_GERAL','Tarefas internas'],
        ['DISTRIBUICAO_PROCESSO','DistribuiÃ§Ãµes processuais']
      ].forEach(([value,label])=>{
        const option=el('option',label);
        option.value=value;
        type.append(option);
      });
      type.value=filters.tipo;

      const tag=el('select');
      const allTag=el('option','Todas as tags');
      allTag.value='';
      tag.append(allTag);
      (data.tags||[]).forEach(item=>{
        const option=el('option',item.nome);
        option.value=String(item.nome||'').toUpperCase();
        tag.append(option);
      });
      tag.value=filters.tag;

      const due=el('select');
      [
        ['','Todos os prazos'],
        ['ATE_96H','Prazo inferior a 96h'],
        ['ATE_24H','Prazo inferior a 24h'],
        ['VENCIDA','Vencidas']
      ].forEach(([value,label])=>{
        const option=el('option',label);
        option.value=value;
        due.append(option);
      });
      due.value=filters.prazo;

      const apply=()=>{
        filters.busca=search.value;
        filters.tipo=type.value;
        filters.tag=tag.value;
        filters.prazo=due.value;
        saveFilters_();
        paint_(data);
      };

      search.addEventListener('input',apply);
      type.addEventListener('change',apply);
      tag.addEventListener('change',apply);
      due.addEventListener('change',apply);

      [search,type,tag,due].forEach(node=>bar.append(node));
      return bar;
    };

    const paint_=data=>{
      content.replaceChildren();

      const tasks=(data.tarefas||[]).filter(taskMatches_);
      const urgent=(data.tarefas||[]).filter(task=>
        ['ATE_96H','ATE_24H','VENCIDA'].includes(task.vencimentoEstado)
      ).length;

      const head=el('div',undefined,'tasks-head');
      const copy=el('div');

      copy.append(
        el('h2',mode==='history'?'HistÃ³rico de tarefas':'Minhas tarefas'),
        el(
          'p',
          mode==='history'
            ?'As tarefas concluÃ­das sÃ£o consultadas somente quando vocÃª abre este histÃ³rico.'
            :'Prioridade para tarefas vencidas ou com prazo inferior a 96 horas.',
          'hint'
        )
      );

      const actions=el('div',undefined,'tasks-head-actions');

      if(mode==='open'){
        if(App.can('gestao_distribuicao')||App.can('criar_tarefa_entidade')){
          const create=button(
            '+ Nova tarefa',
            ()=>App.createTaskForPerson(
              null,
              async()=>{
                openData=null;
                await render();
              }
            ),
            true
          );
          create.classList.add('tasks-create-button');
          actions.append(create);
        }

        if(
          data.podeAssumirDistribuicao&&
          Number(
            data.distribuicoesDisponiveis||
            0
          )>0
        ){
          const claim=
            button(
              'Assumir distribuiÃ§Ã£o ('+
              Number(
                data.distribuicoesDisponiveis||
                0
              )+
              ')',
              async()=>{
                claim.disabled=true;

                try{
                  const result=
                    await call(
                      'tarefaDistribuicaoAssumirProxima',
                      {},
                      true
                    );

                  status(
                    result.mensagem||
                    'DistribuiÃ§Ã£o atualizada.'
                  );

                  if(result.ok&&result.tarefa){
                    openData=null;
                    await render();
                    App.refreshTaskNotifications()
                      .catch(()=>{});
                  }else{
                    data.distribuicoesDisponiveis=0;
                    paint_(data);
                  }
                }finally{
                  if(claim.isConnected){
                    claim.disabled=false;
                  }
                }
              }
            );

          claim.classList.add(
            'tasks-claim-button'
          );

          actions.append(claim);
        }

        const history=button(
          'HistÃ³rico',
          async()=>{
            mode='history';
            if(!historyData){
              content.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
              historyData=await call('tarefasMinhasHistorico',{limit:100,offset:0});
            }
            paint_(historyData);
          },
          true
        );
        history.classList.add('tasks-history-button');
        actions.append(history);
      }else{
        actions.append(
          button(
            'Voltar Ã s abertas',
            ()=>{
              mode='open';
              paint_(openData);
            },
            true
          )
        );
      }

      const summary=el('div',undefined,'tasks-summary');
      summary.append(
        el('span',undefined,'tasks-summary-item'),
        el('span',undefined,'tasks-summary-item urgent')
      );
      summary.children[0].append(el('strong',String((data.tarefas||[]).length)),document.createTextNode(mode==='history'?' concluÃ­das':' abertas'));
      summary.children[1].append(el('strong',String(mode==='history'?0:urgent)),document.createTextNode(' com atenÃ§Ã£o <96h'));

      head.append(copy,summary,actions);
      content.append(head,filterBar_(data));

      const section=el('section',undefined,'tasks-section');
      const sectionHead=el('div',undefined,'tasks-section-head');
      sectionHead.append(
        el('h3',mode==='history'?'ConcluÃ­das':'Abertas'),
        el('span',tasks.length+' resultado(s)','hint')
      );

      const grid=el('div',undefined,'tasks-grid');

      if(!tasks.length){
        grid.append(
          el('div',mode==='history'
            ?'Nenhuma tarefa concluÃ­da encontrada com esses filtros.'
            :'Nenhuma tarefa aberta encontrada com esses filtros.','task-empty')
        );
      }else{
        tasks.forEach(task=>{
          const card=task.tipo==='DISTRIBUICAO_PROCESSO'
            ?distributionCard_(task,openTask_)
            :generalCard_(task,openTask_);
          grid.append(card);
        });
      }

      section.append(sectionHead,grid);
      content.append(section);

      if(mode==='history'&&data.hasMore){
        const more=button(
          'Carregar mais concluÃ­das',
          async()=>{
            more.disabled=true;
            more.textContent='Carregandoâ€¦';

            try{
              const next=await call(
                'tarefasMinhasHistorico',
                {
                  limit:100,
                  offset:(data.tarefas||[]).length
                }
              );

              historyData=Object.assign({},data,{
                tarefas:[
                  ...(data.tarefas||[]),
                  ...(next.tarefas||[])
                ],
                hasMore:next.hasMore,
                total:next.total,
                offset:0,
                limit:(data.tarefas||[]).length+(next.tarefas||[]).length
              });

              paint_(historyData);
            }catch(e){
              more.disabled=false;
              more.textContent='Carregar mais concluÃ­das';
              throw e;
            }
          },
          true
        );

        more.classList.add('tasks-history-more');
        content.append(more);
      }

      content.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    };

    const render=async()=>{
      content.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');

      if(mode==='history'){
        historyData=await call('tarefasMinhasHistorico',{limit:100,offset:0});
        if(!alive(ctx))return;
        paint_(historyData);
      }else{
        openData=await call('tarefasMinhasAbertas',{});
        if(!alive(ctx))return;
        paint_(openData);
      }
    };

    const instant=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'tasks-instant-head'
      );

    instant.append(
      el(
        'h2',
        'Minhas tarefas'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Atividades abertas, prioridades e novas manifestaÃ§Ãµes.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    content.append(instant);

    await render();

    if(
      requestedTaskSelection&&
      requestedTaskSelection.task
    ){
      try{
        await openTask_(
          requestedTaskSelection.task
        );
      }catch(error){
        status(
          error.message||
          'Não foi possível abrir a tarefa.',
          true
        );
      }
    }
  };
})();
</script>
